init.description:
**Direct**: module talks to Azure cloud normally, HA polls via TCP.

**Local + Cloud Keepalive**: module traffic is intercepted locally, but registration and sensor data are mirrored to Azure so the mobile app still works. Requires [DNS override and firewall DNAT](https://github.com/pafernanr/homeassistant-4heatlite/blob/main/docs/PROXY_MODES.md#network-setup-openwrt).

**Local Only**: fully offline, no Azure communication. The 4HEAT mobile app will show the device as offline.
